properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued October 15 at 1:57PM CDT until October 15 at 4:45PM CDT by NWS San Angelo TX
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Fisher County in west central Texas...
Northwestern Jones County in west central Texas...
Nolan County in west central Texas...

* WHEN...Until 445 PM CDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 151 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have
fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 1 to 2 inches are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Sweetwater, Hamlin, Roscoe, Blackwell, Rotan, Roby, Longworth,
Sylvester, Champion, Hobbs, Mccaulley, Maryneal, Lake Sweetwater,
and Camp Boothe Oaks.
- This includes Interstate 20 between Mile Markers 229 and 257.

This includes the following Low Water Crossings...
SH 70 crossing The Draw Southeast of Rotan, US 180 crossing 7
miles west of Roby, IH 20 frontage roads crossing Bitter Creek,
FM 611 crossing 7 miles west of Rotan, IH 20 frontage roads
crossing Towd Creek, IH 20 frontage roads crossing Plum Creek, FM
611 crossing 1 mile west of Rotan, FM 2035 crossing Bitter Creek,
IH 20 frontage roads crossing Sweetwater Creek and FM 1170
crossing Eagle Creek.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

* WHAT...Flash flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be

following areas, in southwest Texas, Central Brewster, Chinati
Mountains, Chisos Basin, Davis Mountains, Davis Mountains
Foothills, Lower Brewster County, Marfa Plateau, Pecos, Presidio

Winkler.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.

crossings may be flooded.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Moisture from Hurricane Simon will stream over West Texas the
next several days. Periods of heavy rain are expected from this
system that will likely cause flash flooding, especially in urban
areas and low water crossings where drainage is poor.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:

should Flash Flood Warnings be issued.
